Then, we can see that we have $9=BC\cdot\frac{3}{5}$, so $BC=9\cdot\frac{5}{3}=15$. From

When $x<1$ or $x>5$, $-x^2+bx-5<0$. That means that $-x^2+bx-5=0$ at $x=1$ and $x=5$. So,
the parabola has roots at 1 and 5, giving us $(x-1)(x-5)=0$. However, we also know the
parabola opens downwards since the coefficient of $x^2$ is negative, so we have to negate
one of the factors. We can now write $-x^2+bx-5=(1-x)(x-5)=-x^2+6 x-5$. Thus,
$b=\boxed{6}$.
